reference.sourcePolicy: Official public product page and official public manual only; behavior reference, no source or asset reuse.

directAudioComparison.reason: No locally installed Serum 2 AU, VST3, AAX, or application was found. No reference audio or performance result is inferred.

rows.reference: Serum 2 installs alongside Serum 1 and does not automatically replace existing projects.
rows.lumen: Lumen has an independent legacy lumen-hybrid-synth identity and lumen namespace; Aether remains wavetable-synth. The preserved internal names keep existing projects compatible.

rows.reference: Three main oscillator slots A-C plus dedicated sub and noise.
rows.lumen: Schema v15 retains the fixed, validated A/B/C rack with bounded simultaneous Wavetable/Sample/Multisample/Granular selection in every slot.

rows.reference: Wavetable, multisample, sample, granular, and spectral modes are selectable in main oscillator slots.
rows.lumen: Wavetable, sample, multisample, and granular playback are verified independently in A-C. Lumen also exposes prepared harmonic-domain wavetable warps, but not a separate time/frequency spectral source mode.

rows.reference: Wavetables can be created, imported, edited, morphed, and manipulated in realtime.
rows.lumen: Lumen inherits Beat's drawn, generated, imported-audio, and resynthesized wavemap records, frame analysis, editable partial overlays, and realtime position/warp control.

rows.reference: Dual warps and smooth wavetable interpolation.
rows.lumen: Two serial runtime warp stages and immutable timbral-frame interpolation exist in the inherited renderer.

rows.reference: Sample mode supports pitch playback, looping, loop modulation, rate effects, slicing, score extraction, and tails behavior.
rows.lumen: Every slot supports bounded start/end ranges, loops, pitch/root mapping, level/pan, zones, Forward/Reverse direction, 0.25x-4x playback rate, Forward/Ping-pong loop traversal, a 1-2000 ms note-off tail, and up to 16 stable-ID manual slices in Sample mode. A selected slice constrains decoded, mapped, and SFZ playback plus reverse/loop/tail behavior while preserving the Full Region. Multisample retains its established neutral playback policy. Automatic transient slicing/snap, snap-loop detection, tape-stop automation, score extraction, and specialized tails modes remain absent.

rows.reference: Multisample mode supports real-instrument mappings and SFZ import.
rows.lumen: Every slot supports bounded key/velocity zones and managed SFZ metadata through the shared verified sampler renderer while retaining Multisample identity.

rows.reference: Granular mode provides deep grain-based time, pitch, position, and texture manipulation.
rows.lumen: Every slot owns deterministic granular audio, root pitch, level, position/spread, grain length, density, pitch, stereo spread, seed, routing, and sends. The current engine is intentionally bounded and does not claim Serum's complete granular control surface.

rows.reference: Spectral mode performs harmonic resynthesis with independent time/frequency and transient-aware processing.
rows.lumen: Schema v15 now prepares and caches five harmonic-domain wavetable deformations, but no independent time/frequency, transient-aware spectral source is exposed. The full source mode remains a separate measured milestone.

rows.reference: Each oscillator/filter can target Filter 1/2 mix, Main, Direct, None, and Bus 1/2 sends.
rows.lumen: A/B/C wavetable and sample sources independently target the shared filter, Filter 1, Filter 2, Direct, or None while retaining two source sends.

rows.reference: Main plus two routable FX busses.
rows.lumen: Two fixed pre-insert source sends target Beat return buses; ordered Lumen instrument inserts process the main route before track inserts, missing targets are silent, and identity/order/bypass/routing survive native save/reopen with sample-identical rendering.

rows.reference: Oscillators and filters can route through Filter 1, Filter 2, a mix between them, Main, Direct, None, and bus sends.
rows.lumen: A/B/C independently target Shared Filter, Filter 1, Filter 2, Direct, or None; the dual-filter and bus graph is visible, persisted, and shared by live/export paths.

rows.reference: Configurable envelopes/LFOs and broad modulation assignment.
rows.lumen: Inherits four envelopes, ten LFO slots, eight macros, performance/MPE sources, deterministic route ordering, and native/browser modulation of Slot C position, fine, level, pan, detune, and spread.

rows.reference: The modulation matrix supports source and auxiliary curves, bypass, reordering, expanded views, and dynamic visualization.
rows.lumen: Beat exposes ordered enabled/disabled routes, bipolar policy, macro definitions, conflict summaries, source lanes, and dynamic browser/native evaluation. Arbitrary per-route custom source/aux curves and full Serum-style matrix visualization are incomplete.

rows.reference: Integrated arpeggiator and MIDI clip sequencer with key, scale, and swing context.
rows.lumen: Schema v11 retains the synth-owned arpeggiator and adds a mutually exclusive, disabled-by-default 1-32-step, 64-note polyphonic clip with relative pitch, chords, note length, velocity, rests, four tempo divisions, pair-preserving swing, exact note-offs, and the shared Beat piano roll. Reusable MIDI patterns can now be imported without instrument ownership while retaining relative pitches, timing, lengths, and velocities. Both use Beat's sample-accurate route MIDI boundary and transport tempo/speed. Clip banks, live recording, macro automation, and preview-clip designation remain gaps.

rows.reference: Serum 2 includes a mature preset workflow and large factory library.
rows.lumen: Lumen identity survives Beat synth preset normalization through its stable legacy identifiers, and seven Beat-authored test-bank archetypes cover its current feature lanes. Preview-clip designation, broader tagging/audition workflow, and production content depth remain incomplete.

rows.reference: Serum 1 presets load in Serum 2, while Serum 2 presets do not load in Serum 1.
rows.lumen: No implicit migration. Eligible Aether library entries expose an explicit Clone as Lumen action that creates a derived v15 Lumen instrument, preserves the original and derivation lineage, carries oscillator/filter/modulation/macro/effect state forward, and keeps Source C, Arp, Clip, Sample slice selection, and spectral warp modes disabled or neutral.

rows.reference: Official guidance states equivalent Serum 1 patches should use the same or less CPU in Serum 2.
rows.lumen: Two frozen Beat-authored Aether benchmark patches are cloned through the explicit production path and measured at 44.1/48/96 kHz, 128/512-sample blocks, and 1/4/8 submitted voices. Eight of eight frontend offline-render rows are byte-identical with equal active oscillator-lane work. The verified 1.083382 aggregate and 1.089869 maximum row median wall ratios pass the explicit 1.10 aggregate / 1.15 row budgets; telemetry attributes the bounded overhead to Lumen checking one additional disabled Source C. Frozen Aether hashes remain independently enforced. This is not a Serum 2 CPU or parity claim.

rows.reference: Sound and CPU parity require the same patch, host, rate, quality, latency, and renderer conditions.
rows.lumen: Aether regression hashes and Lumen live/export paths are tested, but no local Serum 2 renderer is installed, so no direct audio, null, preset, or CPU parity is claimed.
